Bubble Heatmap Archetypes (Diamond, Circle, Square, and Diverging)

Source: R/type_bubble_heatmap.R
type_bubble_heatmap.Rd

Creates a matrix of bubbles where marker-sample combinations are encoded simultaneously by shape size (e.g., effect magnitude, |log2FC|, -log10 P, or abundance) and colour (e.g., continuous significance, directional NES, or log2FC). Supports multiple glyph shapes (diamond, circle, square, triangle), sequential and diverging publication palettes, significance asterisks, and customizable matrix backgrounds (banded, grid, minimal).

Usage

type_bubble_heatmap(
  shape = c("diamond", "circle", "square", "triangle_up", "triangle_down"),
  palette_type = c("sequential", "diverging"),
  palette = NULL,
  fill_low = "#D6E4F0",
  fill_mid = "#59B8A8",
  fill_high = "#A83D62",
  midpoint = 0,
  limits = NULL,
  min_size = 1,
  max_size = 9,
  stroke_col = "white",
  stroke_width = 0.65,
  point_alpha = 0.95,
  grid_style = c("banded", "grid", "minimal", "none"),
  band_alpha = 0.6,
  band_fill = "#F2F5FA",
  cell_border = "#E2E6EF",
  label_metric = c("value", "signif", "none"),
  label_threshold = 1.5,
  signif_cutoffs = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
  signif_labels = c("*", "**", "***"),
  label_size = 2.4,
  label_col = "#182033",
  size_name = "|log₂FC|",
  fill_name = expression(-log[10] ~ "adjusted P"),
  axis_text_size = NULL,
  axis_text_angle = 45,
  transpose = FALSE
)

Arguments

shape

Shape of the bubble glyphs: "diamond" (23, default), "circle" (21), "square" (22), "triangle_up" or "triangle" (24), "triangle_down" (25), or an integer shape code (21–25).

palette_type

Color gradient type: "sequential" (default) or "diverging".

palette

Named publication palette or color vector:

  • Diverging: "nature", "rdbu", "bipolar", "lancet", "spectral", "piyg", "prgn", "dark".

  • Sequential: "mako", "rocket", "viridis", "plasma", "blues", "reds", "ylorrd", "purples".

fill_low, fill_mid, fill_high

Explicit colour stops for the fill gradient when palette = NULL.

midpoint

Value representing the midpoint for diverging palettes (default 0).

limits

Numeric vector of length 2 specifying fill scale limits.

min_size, max_size

Point size range (defaults min_size = 1.0, max_size = 9.0).

stroke_col

Outline stroke colour for bubbles (default "white").

stroke_width

Outline stroke width (default 0.65).

point_alpha

Bubble fill transparency (default 0.95).

grid_style

Background matrix style: "banded" (alternating row stripes with borders, default), "grid" (clean tile matrix borders without stripes), "minimal" (subtle grid guides), or "none".

band_alpha

Opacity for alternating row bands in banded style (default 0.6).

band_fill

Fill colour for alternating row bands (default "#F2F5FA").

cell_border

Border colour for guide tiles (default "#E2E6EF").

label_metric

Content of glyph text labels: "value" (numeric size value if above threshold), "signif" (significance asterisks *, **, ***), or "none".

label_threshold

Size threshold above which cell labels are drawn when label_metric = "value" (default 1.5).

signif_cutoffs

Significance thresholds for asterisks when label_metric = "signif" (default c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001)).

signif_labels

Asterisk labels corresponding to cutoffs (default c("*", "**", "***")).

label_size

Font size for cell text labels (default 2.4).

label_col

Font colour for cell text labels (default "#182033").

size_name

Legend title for the size scale.

fill_name

Legend title for the fill colour scale.

axis_text_size

Size of axis text. If NULL (default), adaptively scaled.

axis_text_angle

Angle for x-axis labels (default 45).

transpose

If TRUE, swaps rows and columns (default FALSE).

Value

A cliplot_type object.
